content: When the wind of change blows, some build walls while others build windmills.
author: Chinese Proverbs
explanation: Change is the sovereign law of the universe; clinging to obsolete structures in the face of shifting reality is futile. The fearful person frantically erects stone barriers to keep the new world out, while the visionary harnesses the exact same kinetic gale to grind wheat and pump clean water.
practicalInsight: Look at an unexpected disruption in your work or life today not as an enemy, but as raw energy you can redirect toward innovation.
reflectionPrompt: Where are you exhausting yourself building defensive walls against changes that are inevitable?
